about.label: About
about.title: About me
about.p1: Hi, I'm <name>Sebastian Cetina</name>, a Systems Engineering student from Bogotá, Colombia. I focus on backend development with <hl>Java</hl> and <hl>Spring Boot</hl>.
about.p2: In my university projects I've built a hospital operational status monitor using hexagonal architecture, an equipment tracking system secured with Spring Security, and a JavaFX desktop app that applies the DAO, Singleton and Facade patterns. I use PostgreSQL for data and Docker to run everything the same way on any machine.
about.p3: I enjoy programming in general, but backend is where I want to focus. I like designing and implementing the logic that makes an application work. Its results are less visible than a user interface, but I enjoy seeing how the backend connects to the frontend and shapes the user experience.
about.p4: I work on Linux day to day, I'm learning AWS (I've completed Cloud Practitioner Essentials) and I'm improving my English because I know it matters for my career.
